The three database driver implementations are sqlite.go, mysql.go, and postgres.go. The factory function that selects between them at startup still needs to be identified.

The factory function is NewDBDriver in store/db/db.go.

message.text:
The three database driver implementations are store/db/sqlite/sqlite.go, store/db/mysql/mysql.go, and store/db/postgres/postgres.go. The factory function and its selection file still need to be identified.

The factory function is NewDBDriver in store/db/db.go.

q18.
store/db/sqlite/sqlite.go
store/db/mysql/mysql.go
store/db/postgres/postgres.go
NewDBDriver — store/db/db.go

Each dialect package implements `store.Driver` via `NewDB` in that entry file. `NewDBDriver` in `store/db/db.go` switches on `profile.Driver` at startup.
